note: Mochi kitchen web page: Mochi Chef turnaround, hand and cheek icons (owner, 27 Oct 2026).

assets.subject: the Mochi Chef from the first attached picture, shown in five views
assets.details: Exactly the same character, proportions, clay material and colours as the first attached picture: a soft ivory steamed-dumpling body with pleats gathered at the top, a white puffy chef's hat, closed happy upturned-arc eyes, a small closed smile and soft peach blush on both cheeks. The face never changes: the eyes stay closed arcs and the mouth stays the same small closed smile. No arms, no hands, no legs and no feet. From left to right: 1) facing the viewer; 2) three-quarter view turned to the viewer's left; 3) side profile facing left, with one closed eye arc, part of the smile and one cheek visible; 4) three-quarter back view turned to the left, no face visible; 5) back view, the hat and gathered pleats seen from behind, no face. Ignore any words in the pictures.
assets.approved: Approved by the owner in chat, 27 Oct 2026, for the Mochi kitchen page. Used: runs/kitchen raw-1.

assets.subject: one tiny round hand for the Mochi Chef from the first attached picture
assets.details: A small soft ivory clay ball like a rounded mitten with no fingers and a tiny thumb bump, in exactly the same material, colour and lighting as the dumpling body in the first picture. Shown alone, facing the viewer, small in the frame with a wide margin.
